// Maths to figure out how to do days until the due date in milliseconds

const millisecondInOneWholeDay = 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24
function CalculateDaysUntilTheDeadline(oneAssignment) {
    const rightNowMoment = new Date();
                                            console.log(rightNowMoment);
    const millisecondsRemaining = oneAssignment.dueDate - rightNowMoment;
    const daysRemaining = Math.floor(millisecondsRemaining/millisecondInOneWholeDay);
    return daysRemaining;
};

    console.log(CalculateDaysUntilTheDeadline(oneAssignment));
